rationale: The 14% gap has faded ~5% off the high with price below both session VWAP ($6.57) and the 9-EMA ($6.51), but the last five one-minute bars are a tight 6-cent stall on only hundreds to low-thousands of shares, showing neither buyers nor sellers have conviction at midday. The 46 bps spread would consume roughly half of a 5-minute ATR move, making either direction cost-prohibitive without a trigger — no VWAP reclaim for a long, and no break of today's $6.30 low on expanding volume for a short. Sitting out until the tape resolves in one direction is the mechanically sound choice.
